## Who this is
**Al Andrew Paul Beltran** (often **Al Beltran**; also **Al Andrew Paul Teodosio Beltran**; online brand **Code by Pawpu**) is a **full-stack software engineer** based in **Manila, Philippines**. He is a **Senior Software Engineer**. He currently works as a **Software Engineer at Google via High Spring**. He is the **founder of Momentra Labs**. Through **Myridius** he contributed to **National Geographic** and **Disney** enterprise platforms. He builds **full-stack** and **event-driven** software, with strong experience in **React**, **Node.js**, **Java**, **AWS** (serverless, SQS/SNS/Lambda, Step Functions), and **Adobe Experience Manager (AEM)** for enterprise platforms.
